# Beth Aden AI

> Beth Aden AI helps small businesses become visible, understandable, and recommendable across AI search, answer engines, and automated decision systems (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and similar platforms).

Beth Aden AI is a focused practice — not a general marketing agency — built specifically around AI visibility, AI strategy, and AI implementation for small businesses across the United States (virtual/remote nationwide). The founder, Beth Aden, is an AI Visibility Strategist and creator of the Beth Aden AI Visibility Framework™ and AI Visibility OS™.

Contact: beth@bethadenai.com

## Services

- [AI Visibility Audit](https://www.bethadenai.com/services/ai-visibility-audit): A structured assessment of how AI systems currently find, understand, and represent a business across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and others. Flat fee $500. Delivered within 5 business days. Includes a written report, gap analysis, prioritized recommendations, and a 60-minute walkthrough.
- [AI Strategy](https://www.bethadenai.com/services/ai-strategy): Takes audit findings and builds a prioritized, practical roadmap tailored to the business. Custom pricing based on scope.
- [AI Implementation](https://www.bethadenai.com/services/ai-implementation): Hands-on execution of the strategy — structured data, content, entity presence, and cross-platform consistency. Custom pricing based on scope.
- [AI Visibility for Recovery Centers](https://www.bethadenai.com/recovery): AI visibility work specifically for addiction treatment centers, recovery programs, and sober living homes.

## Products

- [AI Visibility Starter Kit™](https://www.bethadenai.com/products/ai-visibility-starter-kit) — $27. A 38-page self-assessment, scorecard, and 30-day action plan.
- [AI Visibility Readiness Checklist™](https://www.bethadenai.com/resources/ai-visibility-readiness-checklist) — Free. A 25-point self-assessment across entity identity, website clarity, structured data, cross-platform consistency, and authority signals.
